content.text: bisphos = class of choice; zoledronic acid = first-line in professional guidelines - alendronate · risedronate & pamidronate = second-line; zoledronic acid & pamidronate IV - others PO; hypocalcemia after zoledronic acid w 25-OH vitD ≤ 10 ng/mL - > 25 ng/mL = suggested. salmon calcitonin = alt if intolerant of or resistant to bisphos
Zoledronic acid (Reclast) dose, Paget's dz of bone:

Paget's dz: single 5 mg IV infusion. Infusion time ⍉ < 15 min given over a constant infusion rate. Paget's dz: 1500 mg elemental Ca daily in divided doses (750 mg BID or 500 mg three times a day) & 800 international units vitD daily, particularly in the 2 wks after Reclast

CI: hypocalcemia. CI: CrCl < 35 mL/min & evidence of acute renal impairment (↑ risk of renal failure). Hypocalcemia may worsen during tx - pts must be adequately supplemented w Ca & vitD. Renal toxicity: single dose ⍉ exceed 5 mg - infusion ⍉ < 15 min - risk may be greater w underlying renal impairment or RF (advanced age · dehydration) - monitor CrCl b4 each dose. ONJ reported - all pts should have a routine oral exam by the prescriber b4 tx. Atypical frx incl femoral frx reported - pts w thigh or groin pain should be evaluated to r/o femoral frx - re-evaluate risk/benefit & consider interrupting bisphos therapy. Acetaminophen after Reclast may reduce incidence of acute-phase rxn Sx. Severe bone · joint & musc pain may occur - withhold future doses of Reclast if severe Sx occur. Loop diuretics: caution ← ↑ risk of hypocalcemia. Aminoglycosides: caution w bisphos incl zoledronic acid (additive effect to ↓ serum Ca for prolonged periods). OD may cause renal impairment · hypocalcemia · hypophosphatemia & hypomagnesemia - correct w IV calcium gluconate · potassium or sodium phosphate & magnesium sulfate
Calcitonin salmon (Miacalcin) dose, Paget's dz of bone:
Sxtomatic Paget's dz: 100 USP Units (0.5 mL) per day SC or IM

CI: hypersensitivity to calcitonin salmon or any excipients (rxns incl anaphylaxis w death, bronchospasm, & swelling of the tongue or throat). Serious hypersensitivity rxns incl fatal anaphylaxis reported - consider skin testing b4 tx in pts w sus hypersensitivity to calcitonin salmon. Hypocalcemia w tetany (musc cramps · twitching) & sz activity reported - hypocalcemia must be corrected b4 initiating therapy. Meta-analysis of 21 trials suggests ↑ risk of overall malig in calcitonin salmon-treated pts. Circulating antibodies to calcitonin salmon may develop & may cause loss of response to tx. Use for Paget's dz or postmenopausal osteoporosis = recommended w adequate intake of Ca & vitD. Concomitant lithium may ↓ plasma lithium concentrations (↑ urinary clearance) - lithium dose may require adj. OD: hypocalcemic tetany could occur - keep parenteral calcium available for tx. MC adverse rxns: nausea w or w.o vomiting (10%) · inj site inflam (10%) & flushing of the face or hands (2% to 5%). ←the poss assoc b/n malig & calcitonin salmon use, the need for continued therapy should be re-evaluated periodically
